task_summary: Evidence-bounded interpretation of a user-authorized local text record; no source content or personal assessments included in archive.
workflow_version: WORKFLOW_REVIEW.md and WORKFLOW_DATABASE.md read in current chat

acceptance: Distinguish observable text, inference, and facts requiring external verification.
Check proposed contradictions against nearby context and speaker identity.
Provide non-coercive next-step guidance without invented probability precision.
completed: Coordinator checked source snippets and chronology against local structured records.
One read-only independent reviewer supplied six contextualized findings and alternatives.
Synthesis distinguishes self-presentation from falsification, and conversational interest from future commitments.

observations: Independent review corroborated source attribution and identified that an apparent contradiction belonged to the opposite speaker.
No probability calibration or independent ground truth; percentages would overstate evidence.
Review text kept separate from private source and interpretation; no personal details uploaded.
One additional reviewer improves cross-check coverage, but no matched baseline establishes efficiency benefit.

recommendations.action: For private-record interpretation, verify speaker and context first, list alternatives, and keep unsupported mind-reading and numerical confidence out of conclusions.
recommendations.next_check: Next interpretation: spot-check evidence attribution and ensure every forecast is marked conditional.

evidence: Coordinator performed bounded source reads with speaker and timestamp fields.
Independent reviewer returned six findings with source timestamps and alternative explanations; private findings retained only within authorized task context.
limits: Text records are not independent verification of described events or intentions.
Missing recalled content and unparsed media restrict contradiction analysis.
No scientific lie-detection result or long-term outcome prediction is claimed.
